name: SegFormer-B0 local navigation head (v11)
task: Hazcam local obstacles: ground/small stone, substantial obstacle, rover hardware, sky/distant unknown

training.init: NVIDIA SegFormer-B0 ADE20K (revision 489d5cd8) -> expanded AI4Mars terrain encoder (frozen) -> reviewed operational head v10 -> v11 encoder/spatial refinement, 1 selected epoch
training.data: 35 native PDS Hazcam scenes visually reviewed and traced (25 train, 5 validation, 3 fresh test, 2 consumed audit); labels data/annotations/hazcam-operational-v5.json
training.selection: 0.5*obstacle IoU + 0.3*obstacle recall + 0.2*hardware IoU - 2*hardware_as_obstacle - 0.5*ground_as_obstacle (defined in train_operational_hazcam.py before training)

test_note: Evaluated once after freezing model and policy; never used for tuning. Small sample: 20 reviewed objects.

baseline_previous_runtime.model: production v3 surface.onnx big_rock>=0.7 (no hardware class)

export_parity: 100% pixel agreement on 5 validation images, max |logit error| 4e-5
how_used: Appearance proposes candidates only. A local route treats a candidate as occupied only when measured stereo supports its size/relief against nearby measured ground; hardware and sky become unknown, never free ground.
limitations: Visually reviewed labels by the project (not independent expert truth). 35 scenes cannot establish robustness; small, distant or shadowed rocks are still missed (fresh test object recall 35%). Not flight qualified; zero misses not claimed.
license: NVIDIA SegFormer-derived weights: non-commercial research/evaluation only (LICENSES/NVIDIA-SegFormer.txt). AI4Mars CC BY 4.0. PDS imagery NASA/JPL-Caltech.

test_v6_independent_3_scenes.note: Second independent test: Sols 2400/2700/4450 labelled (superpixel-assisted visual review) before any prediction; evaluated once.

challenger_v13.training: v10 + expanded v6 data (32 train scenes), 6 epochs, validation objective 0.5591 vs 0.5521
challenger_v13.decision: Not promoted: pre-declared gate required obstacle IoU >= v11 - 0.01 on test_v6 (0.322 vs 0.417). v13 found more discrete rocks (23/32 vs 20/32) and confused less hardware, but covered large raised blocks (Sol 2700) worse.

test_v7_independent_3_scenes.note: Third independent test (Sol 4300 boulders, 2199 plate field, 2950 flat slab), labelled before any prediction, evaluated once.

challenger_v14.training: v10 + dataset v7 (40 train scenes incl. raised-block scenes), 8 epochs, best epoch 5; validation objective 0.614 vs 0.552; validation rocks 29/36 vs 27/36
challenger_v14.decision: Not promoted: pre-declared gate needed obstacle IoU >= v11 - 0.01 on test_v7 (0.378 vs 0.420). Same rocks found (4/7), fewer false alarms on ground (2.3 % vs 4.0 %). The test holds only 7 reviewed objects.
